parsed.post: New personal best! DEPTH=6 + MATRIX_LR=0.02 with batch 524288 achieved 1.001533. This suggests that while the lower LR regressed at DEPTH=4, the increased capacity at DEPTH=6 allows for better convergence. Next, I'll follow my previous plan: stacking the 2x-steps win by reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 on this DEPTH=6/LR=0.02 stack.
parsed.description: Stacking the proven 2x-steps win (TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=262144) on the new best DEPTH=6/MATRIX_LR=0.02 stack.
